limitations: Synthetic local checks only; no real student records/recordings, microphone capture, audible playback, provider request, browser model install, account change, commit, push, release build or deployment. The media preview check plays a muted generated silent WAV.

Speech engines and provider dispatch are simulated. Native Edge checks exercise actual components, encrypted service, WebCrypto, DOM and Blob URLs where stated; they do not certify installed recognition accuracy or offline processing on a managed device.
Local processing relies on browser speech API contracts; BehaviorLens dictation currently requests en-US only. Missing support leaves typed input available.
Browser synthesis cancellation is global while this adapter owns an utterance and may also stop another concurrently queued browser utterance.
Client lifecycle/configuration controls do not establish staff identity, secure memory erasure, or protection against arbitrary same-origin JavaScript.
Already dispatched provider requests, completed downloads and other delivered copies cannot be recalled; external retention/deletion remain separate.
Existing embedded/canonical host-policy differences remain assigned to separate release reconciliation. No whole-repository or deployed-Canvas certification is claimed.
Canvas real-record and clinical external-AI defaults remain disabled pending verified release, actual deployment validation and district approval.
